Trial 3 behaviour refinement B1 (dev/trial-3-behavior-refinement/): the Skin-Stealer notices the people it sees in its personal space - including those it has decided not to hunt - while it roams or leaves: per-person awareness records fed only by its own sight (at most 4, fading, dropped when stale or gone), a look (it stops and faces them) over its plan without dropping it, its head turned to keep a noticed person in view, a turn toward a fresh sound (its own fuzzy place, no name). Species code only; nothing can attack; no engine, senses or Hound / Smiler change. Trial 3 behaviour refinement B2: what a seen person does raises that person's pressure, each kind only to its own ceiling (in its space, as much as they closed the distance themselves; crowding; circling it - their motion relative to its own, more than 230 degrees one way; following it as it walks; moving into its way; pressing in after a warning); a warning (it turns on them, hunched - act creep, state PROVOKED - backs away for 1.2-1.8 s, then takes another way out), no more than every 4 s after the last; a very hungry departure reconsidered only on fresh sight of somebody it may hunt, after 4 s, at most once a second, never after a lost race. The fade counts all the time since its last look (far away too). Species code only. Trial 3 behaviour refinement B3: a satiated (or any) Skin-Stealer may defend itself against a person it has warned, who keeps pressing it, at pressure 0.8+, between 1 and 15 s after the warning ended, seen within 110 px with a clear way, not backing away; it is not exhausted, has the stamina, and neither its pounce cooldown nor 25 s per person nor 10 s overall holds it back. From its own stream it withdraws (a departure at 180 px/s) or strikes (odds rise when cornered, after earlier withdrawals, with aggression; fall when it is tired; hunger adds a little and never decides it): the pounce's own path with its own values - a 0.5 s wind-up (act wind, the same tell), a 70 px committed lunge that only that person can be caught by, lethal only on contact, the engine's capture and one of the three kills; a miss: the usual recovery and cooldown, then it leaves fast. Hunger is never changed for it; the hungry grab and pounce are unchanged. B5 (after an independent review): the defensive lunge is aimed where it reckons the person will be when it reaches them, never past itself (somebody walking straight at it is met where they are); pressure for pressing in after a warning counts only their own motion and as much as they closed the distance; a warning cut short by a change of plan counts only if it lasted its shortest length; fleeing (a withdrawal) it does not stop to look, but may still warn; a missed defence's departure and the debug LEAVE text are cleared with the rest. Trial 3 predator refinement R1 (species code only; the shared engine untouched): a hunt kept above the plans (the quarry, a belief of where they are, a confidence that falls without evidence - more slowly the hungrier it is - and its tries), an effort budget per person of 30 + 90 x hunger s carried across departures (halving every 90 s), so that leaving and coming back resets nothing; smooth hunger weights in its decisions; being watched is information: a hungry one may go round the person to cover at their side (a flank, at most 3 per hunt, under a person's walk), back off as bait, hold a standoff, or - starving, or very hungry once its flanks and its bait failed - come on openly (a lone ambusher still: more than one person present it holds back); a hungry one that loses the race stops running, does not give chase again for 10 s and keeps to the runner's trail at its free walking pace (top speeds unchanged); out of sight it stops and listens, then goes where it believes them, and gives up for a stated reason (no sign, the trail cold, its time spent); a starving one may take up again a person it left, on a fresh sighting, a few seconds after leaving and within the carried effort. R2: out of sight the hunt takes an anonymous body sound (never a creature's; nobody named, the engine's records untouched) for its quarry's when they could be there by now, and moves its belief there; its guesses come from that belief only - the interception (Trial 3's route walk, now skRoute, with the same draws), along the predicted way, the other way at the same turn, the believed place, the last place - with failed places and turns not tried again and each failure costing confidence; a fitting sound away from the guess revises an interception or a search; roaming and hungry, a sound makes it stop and listen first, and a second fitting sound or a strong first sends it to look; confidence without evidence lasts 10-30 s and a hunt makes 2-4 guesses. R3: coming at somebody unaware it freezes, crouched, when their facing turns its way (before eye contact), until they look away or its patience runs out; waiting at an interception its head sweeps; a flank goes on to its spot even when it has turned away from them; where there is no way round a watcher it remembers that for the place (10 s) and a very hungry one may come on openly; every strike keeps its wind-up. R4: with no flank spot it takes its next answer at once (no tick of holding its ground); a glimpse lost for under 0.6 s does not end an approach or a chase; at its flank spot it settles 0.6 s before it comes on. R6: the per-person records of people who have left the game are dropped (when it left them, its effort), and the no-flank place is forgotten when it is sent far away or cleared. R7 (the independent review): on a runner's trail after a lost race it goes at .85 of their speed (it was their speed + 30), so a lead won stays won while they move, even winded; the effort spent on a person is kept when its attention moves to somebody else; a departure it keeps keeps that person's cooldown; a flank spot is searched for only when going round would be begun; an admin summon ends a hunt; a hunt begun from a record keeps that record's age. Trial 3 R15: the Skin-Stealer's capture.variants gain D, the Rend (a hungry grab with room either side, else nothing - the draw then A-C's own), commitDur.D; ai.capture.js's previewKill no longer refuses the Skin-Stealer's D (its one changed line since 4518f93: s_skinrend.js S15). Trial 3 R16 (the independent review): a waiting spot hides the whole still body (centre and 30 px either side); a watcher's view counts the torches of the people the Skin-Stealer sees now; a failed search for an ambush point is remembered (SK.noFlank); a light's kind as last seen; an open interception runs with the open run's act. Trial 3 R16d (the owner's additional refinement): a new part, ai.skin.preempt.js - the Skin-Stealer's plan interruption and preemption (a viable person newly seen cuts a low-priority plan on that think; a lure or an ambush whose quarry is seen going away is weighed afresh; a committed strike or kill is never cut; one forced reassessment per person every 0.6 s); a person it left is left for a time and taken up again by hunger (from .4, after a refractory, only on sight); hungry, it prowls where it last perceived prey (its own memory) and pauses less; starving, it gives chase from farther at the same speed; a watch keeps through a glimpse lost for a moment (SK.lostGrace). Trial 3 R16e: a new part, ai.skin.look.js - the Skin-Stealer's eyes: its head snaps to a sound it hears (after 0.05-0.09 s), to movement at the edge of its view (a sense of movement only: a clear line, within 0.75 of its sight's distance for that person and 600 px, no identity) and to somebody new in its sight, under any plan that is not committed and never turning its quarry out of view; its body follows beyond the head's reach where it is free to turn; after a sound it looks from where its own sight could make somebody out, then goes closer; a plan's own head movements ease; only prey at hunting hunger preempts a plan. Its sight range unchanged (760). Trial 3 R16f: a new part, ai.skin.move.js - the Skin-Stealer's footwork: within 340 px of a person it sees who is moving or looking at it, in an open approach, a chase or a hungry standoff, it moves with a velocity of its own (its acceleration; sideways and backward slower; never over its run) facing them, taking its place toward their way out from its own lagging read of their motion; the admin debug block carries its last interruption, its eyes' stimulus and its footwork.
